experiment.name: jepa_v5_contrastive_prefix_mask_hard_disjoint
experiment.description: Prefix-grouped hard-disjoint action JEPA with multi-positive InfoNCE.
experiment.notes:
Context sees x[:t], while the EMA target encoder sees only m_{t+1}.
Positives and negatives are selected exactly as in v6 via prefix-grouped
batches. Same-prefix rows are positives. Different-prefix rows are
negatives, except same-action false negatives are handled with the same
per-pair phantom-token replacement used by v6. This is intended to isolate
the v6 batch/target semantics while using InfoNCE instead of
distance-margin loss.
